manaNeeded: {5}{U}{U} each turn plus {5} each turn beyond the first
description:
Cast Alrund's Epiphany by paying its mana cost, creating two 1/1 Bird creature tokens, then causing you to take an extra turn after this one and exile Alrund's Epiphany
Activate Mirror of Fate by tapping and sacrificing it, choosing Alrund's Epiphany and up to six other exiled cards, then exiling your library and putting the chosen cards on top of your library. Ensure Alrund's Epiphany is the top card of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Alrund's Epiphany from your library during your draw step.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Mirror of Fate from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Mirror of Fate from your graveyard by paying {5}.
Repeat.
